newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Sweden Dec jobless rate rises to 8.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Sweden Dec jobless rate rises to 8.1 pct.

text.p: Swedish unemployment was expected to rise to 8.1 percent in December from 7.9 percent in November, a Reuters poll of 15 analysts showed on Friday.
Forecasts ranged from 7.3 to 8.7 percent. In December 1995 unemployment was 7.8 percent.
For 1996 the economists polled expect unemployment to run at 8.0 percent. Forecasts ranged from 7.9 percent to 8.1 percent.
In 1995 Sweden's unemployment rate was 7.7 percent.
Statistics Sweden, Sweden's official statistics office, is due to publish the figure on January 17 at 1200 GMT.

Sources: Carnegie, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, J P Morgan, Merrill Lynch, Morgan Stanley, Nordbanken, S-E-Banken, Transferator, Union Bank of Switzerland, Unibank Markets, Ohman Fondkommission.
